title: [Shopify] Fix #7724: Resolve Option 1 Name from existing Shopify Variant records
summary: Fixed a regression where the Option 1 Name for Shopify product variants was being incorrectly reset to 'Variant' instead of preserving existing names like 'Color' or 'Size'. The fix ensures Option 1 Value is always set when the name is resolved from existing Shopify records.
key_points: Regression in product export where Option 1 Name was reset to 'Variant' for Shopify-origin products with existing variants
Root cause was missing guard condition to set Option 1 Value when resolved name differed from 'Variant'
Added JustResolvedOption1Name flag to handle all cases consistently
Five new test scenarios cover Shopify-origin, BC-origin, and ambiguous variant cases
All tests pass with no regressions to existing product export functionality
